content.text: Why does the engine park the disconnect until the next frame?

The convention is not a crutch, it is the only named image this workspace has. The 1.17 dump carries zero curated symbols, so every function there is FUN_<addr>; names, types and RTTI live only on 1.16.2 and have to be carried across by pairing. That is why each row in the table starts from a 1.16.2 address and is mapped forward before use. I'll ask the agent for the return-value contract rather than the 1.16.2 address.
